note: Actual-shipment check: the only verified activity is IMPORT into India (Japan -> Mumbai air cargo, HS 82042000 hand tools/sockets, latest record 2026-02-28, B/L 7799109). No export shipment record was found, so export_status = none_found rather than 'declared'. Domestic supply evidence: no traces found in accessible sources — GST turnover, tenders and contracts are not public here, so recorded as unknown, not as confirmed. HS mismatch flagged: declared HS 902480 (measuring/testing instruments) does not match the observed customs HS 82042000 (interchangeable spanner sockets / hand tools); per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to 82042000 (or 8204 family) and verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'IT и электроника' is not supported by any shipment line; observed goods are hand tools imported from Ko-Ken Tool, Imada Co. and related Japanese suppliers. Role: trader/importer (no manufacturing evidence). Revenue and export volume: null — not public, not estimated. Note also that the name 'Shraddha Impex' is common in Indian trade data and the ImportKey buyer/supplier blocks mix several unrelated entities (e.g. MAAHIVEDAR LLC, MSSL MIDEAST FZE), so entity-level attribution of the 3643 records is uncertain; only the Mumbai Vile Parle address rows were treated as this company.
